as_told.title: Special forces source sees a blacker-than-black hovering sphere overseas

plain: A congressman, Eric Burlison, passes on what a man told him. The man served in special forces and says that while overseas during the wars he was brought into a room where a sphere, blacker than black, hovered in the air. He says it gave off a feeling of complete evil and darkness. Told this way, it hints that something not human, and not friendly, is being held or met in secret.
